## WD Kibana Daily Report — Grafana edition
Same insights as the daily HTML/Slack report (`reports/wd-kibana-logs/`) over **`webgilitydesktop-*`** via the **Elasticsearch-WD** datasource — **no LLM cost**. Use the **time-range picker** (top-right); default is the report window *yesterday 09:00 → today 09:00 IST*. Error Rate = *Errors / Total*. Every panel deep-links to the matching **Kibana Discover** view with the same time range.

panels.title: Error Subscribers
panels.description: Distinct subscriberID with at least one Error

panels.title: Events over time by level
panels.description: Stacked counts by level across the selected window (bucketed automatically).

panels.title: Payouts Processed
panels.description: Sum of processedRecords for Shopify PayoutPosting

options.content: Per-step timing bars in the HTML report come from regex-parsing the free-text `detail` field (`Step N: … ms`) — not natively reproducible in a Grafana panel. The panels below show performance-summary run counts and per-subscriber runs; use the Kibana links for the step breakdown.
